question_text: Describe how a linear regression model could use historical temperature measurements to predict sea-level measurements.
adaptation_rationale: Retains data-derived rule/prediction reasoning by explicitly selecting guide-listed linear regression; does not assess simulation construction.
solution: Use temperature as a predictor and sea level as the continuous response, fit a slope/intercept to paired observations, and use the fitted relation to estimate sea level for a specified temperature. Check fit against observed values before trusting predictions.

marking_points.criterion: Fits a linear relation/slope and intercept from paired data.

verification.technical: Concrete answer reasoned and checked against full syllabus guidance and available source MS.
